Connect to WordPress

Validation goes through the engine adapter. Credentials are never written to project files or logs.

WordPress site URL
The REST API root is discovered automatically.
Authentication mode
Public REST API (no login)
Application password (recommended)
WordPress login session (legacy)
Public posts and pages usually need no login. Drafts, private items and media in a protected library need an application password.
How WordPress access works
Public REST API (no login) — reads published content from /wp-json/wp/v2. No credentials are stored.
Application password (recommended) — WordPress generates a revocable password for this app in Users → Profile. It is different from your normal login password and can be revoked at any time.
Login session (legacy) — some hosts disable it or block it with a security plugin. Prefer an application password when drafts must be read.
The desktop app never exposes your WordPress site or its private APIs to Qortal or the internet.
